text:
Noah: Quick planning thread  we need a tight MVP for the catalog lifecycle called 'Cutover Guardian'  goal: reduce surprise regressions and make migrations auditable. Proposed pillars: ingest validation + smoke bench, transparent pin semantics, migration trial (mirror + optional credit), and a single rollback CTA in console. Thoughts?

Ivy: Love the name. For smoke bench keep it minimal: 150 stratified queries (gen vs embeds), compute quality proxy, p95 latency, and token-cost delta. Show CI and sample size. Run in a cheap CI runner at upload.

Sam: Routing implications: pin semantics must include owner, expires_at, fallback_model, and an exception token that auto-expires. Routing should log fallback reasons and surface them in traces. Canary plan: mirror 1% x 48h -> 10% x 48h -> flip. Always keep a one-click revert.

Priya: CS asks: customers want a short credit window (14 days) and a visible console opt-in. They also want a playbook email and a rollback script. For MVP we do manual credits; automate later.

Noah: UX sketch: model page preview shows current vs candidate mini-diff, a compat badge (green/amber/red), estimate band (Low/Med/High), and a checkbox "Enable 14d migration trial + 1% mirror". Default off.

Ivy: Need required metadata on upload: tokenizer_hash, avg_seq_len, seq_len_histogram. If missing, fail early with clear guidance. Sampling must pin RNG seed and log sample ids for reproducibility.

Sam: Ops: add guardrails - cap mirror QPS per tenant, kill-switch if mirror_p99 > 2x baseline, and alert if quality delta > 2%. OpsBot: ticket REG-6002 created for mirror infra and alerts (assigned Sam).

Priya: Playbook: draft email + rollback steps + how to request manual credit. Also a support UI action to trigger rollback during credit window. I'll draft by Wed.

Noah: Owners & timeline (2 sprints): Ivy = smoke bench + metadata validation, Sam = routing + canary, Priya = playbook + console copy, Noah = small console estimate endpoint. Ship criteria: smoke bench runs on upload, compat badge visible with CI, mirror toggle present, playbook doc published, and manual credit flow documented.

Ivy: I'll commit a sampling notebook and badge logic. Note: with 150 samples CI will be wide; badge should show the CI prominently.

Sam: I'll prototype routing flags and fallback logging. Will also add route for one-click revert.

Priya: I'll prepare the customer email and the support flow.

Noah: OK. Reconvene Fri 9am to review mocks and confirm ship checklist. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
